description: This file defines the CalendarService class which implements calendar-related operations including retrieving events and adding new events using EventKit, specifically for an iOS application.

classes.name: CalendarService
classes.description: A final class implementing calendar operations, including fetching calendar events and adding new events, conforming to the CalendarServicing protocol.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within a specified date range and limits, returning them as a payload object.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event based on provided parameters, returning the created event in a payload object.
